# Niftyimages

Allowing marketers to create dynamic and personalized content for your email campaigns.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/niftyimages/.

## Actions

- **Get Images Stats** (read-only): Get aggregated stats for all images.
- **List Images** (read-only): Page through images in your NiftyImages account.
- **List Widgets** (read-only): List all widgets in your NiftyImages account.
- **Get Widget User Images** (read-only): List widget images for a specific user.
- **Get Widget User Stats** (read-only): Get aggregated stats for a specific user on a widget.
- **List Maps** (read-only): Retrieve all maps in your NiftyImages account.
- **List Widget Images** (read-only): List widget images for a time frame.
- **List widget stats** (read-only): Retrieve widget statistics for a specified time frame from NiftyImages.
- **List Widget Users** (read-only): List widget users for a specified time frame from NiftyImages.
